## Ratan OS and Ratan AI
- Ratan OS v1.0.0 is the original Debian-based x86_64 live ISO and is free to download for authorized security learning and controlled labs.
- Ratan OS Lite v1.1.0 is a compact 697 MiB Debian-based live ISO and is also free to download, with QEMU BIOS and USB lab use supported.
- Ratan OS Lite AI Edition v1.2.0 is a Debian Trixie XFCE live ISO with offline Qwen3-4B Q4_K_M, local CPU-only llama.cpp inference and curated Tool Collections.
- The AI Edition is distributed as one verified Google Drive ISO with GitHub split parts retained as backup; the release page contains checksums and QEMU BIOS instructions.
- The original and Lite downloads require no payment. Optional premium setup support starts at INR 799, with exact deliverables and scope confirmed before payment.
- RATAN AI is a separate learning assistant service; users must not submit production credentials, secrets or sensitive customer data.

## Public service boundaries
- Security services begin only after written authorization, an agreed asset list and a defined scope.
- Starting prices are public guide prices; final fee, deliverables and timeframe are agreed in a written proposal.
- Public labs and the Red-Team Lab are simulated learning environments; no real-target access is provided.
- Do not share passwords, OTPs, API keys, production secrets or customer data in a public inquiry.
